I stayed at the Mercure Algiers Ain Benian from 6 to 11 August 2026, and unfortunately, the overall experience fell well below what I expected from a five-star hotel.

On arrival, there was no baggage handler available. I had to find a trolley, load all our heavy luggage myself and take it to the room. Once inside, we discovered that the fridge was not working, some towels were missing and the toilet door handle was faulty. After several attempts, we eventually managed to get a technician to deal with the problems. As the weather was very hot, not having a working fridge or cold drinking water was particularly inconvenient.

Breakfast was generally fine, although one of the waitresses asked us to move after we had sat at a four-seat table. The restaurant was not busy, so the way this was handled felt unnecessary and rather rude.

The most frustrating issue was housekeeping. On two consecutive days, we left the sign on the door asking for the room to be cleaned, but returned in the evening to find that it had not been done. On the first occasion, the door sign had also disappeared. We informed reception and were assured that the room would be cleaned the following day, but exactly the same thing happened again.

After I complained, I met the manageress in the corridor and explained the situation. She listened, promised to have the room cleaned and followed through. She also left an apology note and a plate of fruit, which I appreciated. However, even after the room was finally cleaned, no drinking water had been provided.

The reception staff were polite and acknowledged our requests, but unfortunately, very little action seemed to follow. This repeated lack of attention and communication made the whole experience feel disorganised and disappointing.

On a positive note, the gym was excellent, and breakfast was generally acceptable. However, the overall standard of service did not reflect a five-star hotel. Based on this stay, I would not return, and I could not recommend this hotel unless management makes significant improvements to its housekeeping, maintenance and customer service.
